أتكافل (form VI)
# أَتَكَافَلُ (ʔatakāfalu) /ʔa.ta.kaː.fa.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَكَافَلَ (takāfala)
# أَتَكَافَلَ (ʔatakāfala) /ʔa.ta.kaː.fa.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَكَافَلَ (takāfala)
# أَتَكَافَلْ (ʔatakāfal) /ʔa.ta.kaː.fal/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَكَافَلَ (takāfala)
